title: 2025 AMC 12A Problem 12
statement: The harmonic mean of a collection of numbers is the reciprocal of the arithmetic mean of the reciprocals of the numbers in the collection. For example, the harmonic mean of \(4,\) \(4,\) and \(5\) is \[\frac{1}{\frac{1}{3}\left(\frac{1}{4} + \frac{1}{4} + \frac{1}{5}\right)} = \frac{30}{7}.\] What is the harmonic mean of all the real roots of the \(4050\)th degree polynomial \[ \begin{aligned} &\small \prod_{k=1}^{2025}(kx^2 - 4x - 3) \\ &= (x^2 - 4x - 3) \\ &\quad {}\cdot (2x^2 - 4x - 3) \\ &\quad {}\cdot (3x^2 - 4x - 3)\cdots \\ &\quad (2025x^2 - 4x - 3)? \end{aligned} \]

solutions.text:
Each factor \(kx^2 - 4x - 3\) has discriminant \(16 + 12k \gt 0,\) so it has two real roots; there are \(4050\) roots in all.

For the roots of \(kx^2 - 4x - 3,\) the sum of reciprocals is \(\dfrac{\text{sum}}{\text{product}} = \dfrac{\frac{4}{k}}{-\frac{3}{k}} = -\dfrac{4}{3},\) independent of \(k.\)

Summing over all \(2025\) factors, \(\displaystyle\sum \frac{1}{r} = 2025\left(-\frac{4}{3}\right) = -2700.\) The harmonic mean is \[\frac{4050}{-2700} = -\frac{3}{2}.\]

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: The harmonic mean is \(\dfrac{N}{\sum \frac{1}{r}},\) where \(N\) is the number of roots
For \(kx^2 - 4x - 3,\) the two roots have reciprocal-sum \(\dfrac{\frac{4}{k}}{-\frac{3}{k}} = -\dfrac{4}{3},\) the same for every \(k\)
